issues_detected.title: Corrosion on Panel
issues_detected.description: The metal enclosure of the electrical panel shows significant rust and corrosion, which may compromise the integrity of the panel.
issues_detected.recommendation: Consult a licensed electrician to assess the extent of the corrosion and replace or repair the panel as necessary.

analysis.overall_assessment: The electrical panel is in poor condition due to visible corrosion, posing potential safety and operational concerns.
